label: dormwar7
title_zh: 无情押韵大乱斗！说唱狂潮！

lines.en: label dormwar7:
scene nightsky
It finally starts getting a little bit colder now that night has begun to set in, but not cold enough to cool my body off as we are currently heading to my favorite place in the world.
lines.zh: 夜幕开始降临，天气终于凉下来了一点，却还不足以让我降火——因为我们正前往这世上我最喜欢的地方。

lines.en: Apparently, Ayane arrived at the cafe in the middle of the test of knowledge, so Uta had to sprint over there to meet up with her the second that contest came to an end.
lines.zh: 据说 Ayane 在知识测验进行到一半时就到了咖啡店，所以那场比赛一结束，Uta 就得冲过去和她汇合。

lines.en: Now, I’m not going to pretend I know anything about rap...
lines.zh: 现在，我可不会假装自己懂说唱……

lines.en: In fact, if you were to quiz me on every single genre of music, that’s the one I’d probably score the lowest in.
lines.zh: 事实上，要是你拿每一种音乐流派来考我，说唱大概是我得分最低的一项。

lines.en: But, then again, there are all sorts of music genres now, so who even knows?
lines.zh: 不过话说回来，现在的音乐流派五花八门，谁说得准呢？

lines.en: Maybe I know more about rap now than I do, like...post-alternative countrycore or something.
lines.zh: 也许我对说唱的了解，比我对什么……后另类乡村核之类的还多呢。

lines.en: Is that a genre?
lines.zh: 那算是个流派吗？

lines.en: I guess that doesn’t matter.
lines.zh: 我想这不重要。

lines.en: What does matter, though, is that I am about to see girls in maid dresses.
lines.zh: 重要的是，我马上就能看到穿女仆装的女生了。

lines.en: So fuck yeah.
lines.zh: 所以，太他妈棒了。

lines.en: scene rapbattle1
: Sensei! Ready to watch me kill a girl?
lines.zh: : Sensei！准备好欣赏我干掉一个女生了吗？

lines.en: : Good evening, Master! Table for one?
lines.zh: : 晚上好，主人！一位吗？

lines.en: : Uta, why aren’t you in costume?
lines.zh: : Uta，你怎么没穿制服？

lines.en: : Because we closed early tonight to hold the rap battle thingy. Duh.
lines.zh: : 因为我们今晚提前打烊，要办说唱对决那档子事。这不是废话嘛。

lines.en: : So there...won't be maid outfits?
lines.zh: : 那么……没有女仆装？

lines.en: : Nope!
lines.zh: : 没有！

lines.en: : At all?
lines.zh: : 一件都没有？

lines.en: : There are some in the back room if ya wanna try one on. None of us girls are wearin’ ‘em, though.
lines.zh: : 后屋倒是放着几件，你想穿可以试试。不过我们女生谁都没穿。

lines.en: : Do you need help putting one on, Sensei?
lines.zh: : 需要我帮您穿吗，Sensei？

lines.en: : It’s not the same if I wear it...
lines.zh: : 我自己穿就没那个味道了……

lines.en: : C’mon! You might look really cute!
lines.zh: : 来嘛！说不定您穿上超可爱的！

lines.en: : You also have the same chest size as Ami, so we could probably find one that fits pretty easily!
lines.zh: : 而且您的胸围和 Ami 差不多，所以我们大概很容易就能找到合身的！

lines.en: : Hey! I didn’t hear whatever you just said, but I feel like it was something mean!
lines.zh: : 喂！我听不清你刚说了什么，但我觉得肯定不是什么好话！

lines.en: : Ahh, youth. Poor girl will get ‘em some day. Just has to believe in herself.
lines.zh: : 啊，青春啊。这可怜的丫头总有一天会有的。只要她相信自己。

lines.en: : Sure. I was just reading a paper about the effects of believing in yourself on the female anatomy the other day.
lines.zh: : 当然。我前几天刚好在读一篇论文，讲自信对女性身体发育的影响。

lines.en: scene rapbattle2
: Holy heck, really? I was just kidding.
lines.zh: : 我靠，真的假的？我只是开个玩笑。

lines.en: : I'm pretty sure mine just came from all the meat I ate and stuff.
lines.zh: : 我的大概就是吃肉吃出来的吧。

lines.en: : See what I’m up against, Sensei? {i}This{/i} is what I have to battle for your love.
lines.zh: : 看到了吗，Sensei？我为了您的爱，得跟{i}这种东西{/i}对抗。

lines.en: : You are as good as mine.
lines.zh: : 您已经算是我的了。

lines.en: scene rapbattle3
: Ooooh, look at this wave of confidence.
lines.zh: : 哦哟，瞧这股自信。

lines.en: : That’s gonna make it all the more sweet once I take you down to Chinatown and claim Sensei for the girls of the second floor! Hoo-rah!
lines.zh: : 等我把你打得落花流水、把 Sensei 抢给二楼的女生们，那才叫痛快！吼——哈！

lines.en: : How is this even going to work? Are you two just going to...see who can rap the most...effectively or something?
lines.zh: : 这到底要怎么比？你们俩就是……看谁说唱得更……有效之类的？

lines.en: scene rapbattle4
: Wow. Really showin’ your age now, aren’t you?
lines.zh: : 哇。可真是暴露年龄了啊。

lines.en: : I’m showing a disinterest in rap. I just want to know how I’m supposed to judge who is better.
lines.zh: : 我暴露的是对说唱毫无兴趣。我只想知道我该怎么评判谁更厉害。

lines.en: : Rap isn’t something you can just {i}judge{/i}, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 说唱不是能随便{i}评判{/i}的东西，Sensei。

lines.en: : Well if it’s not something I can easily judge and no one is wearing a costume, why am I even here?
lines.zh: : 那要是它不好评判、又没人穿制服，我在这儿到底图什么？

lines.en: : Obvs cause there’s a giant magnet inside of me that keeps pulling you over. There’s no other explanation.
lines.zh: : 显然是因为我体内有块巨大的磁铁，一直把您吸过来。没有别的解释了。

lines.en: : Now go sit down and watch me demolish your adopted daughter.
lines.zh: : 现在坐下，看我怎么把您的养女碾成渣。

lines.en: scene rapbattle5
: Don’t worry about me getting “demolished,” Sensei. I’ll be fine.
lines.zh: : 别担心我会被“碾成渣”，Sensei。我没事的。

lines.en: : Sure. {i}But what do I do?{/i}
lines.zh: : 好吧。{i}可我要做什么？{/i}

lines.en: : Just follow your heart!
lines.zh: : 跟着感觉走就好！

lines.en: : Rap’s about feeling the beat and listening to the words. The second we start grading it based on predetermined qualities laid out on a spreadsheet is the second hip hop dies.
lines.zh: : 说唱讲究的是感受节拍、聆听歌词。一旦我们开始照着表格上预设好的条条框框打分，嘻哈就死了。

lines.en: : You’re right on that, Ayane!
lines.zh: : 这点你说得对，Ayane！

lines.en: : And Sensei, shouldn’t a poem nerd like you be all about rap considering it wouldn’t even exist if not for poetry and the effect of spoken word on the human subconscious?
lines.zh: : 还有 Sensei，您这种诗歌迷不更应该喜欢说唱吗？毕竟要是没有诗歌、没有口语对人类潜意识的影响，说唱根本就不会存在。

lines.en: : Why are two [teenage]Japanese girls lecturing me on the origins and importance of rap music?
lines.zh: : 为什么两个[teenage]日本女生在给我上讲说唱音乐的起源和重要性？

lines.en: : Cause you’re closed-minded and trapped in your ways!
lines.zh: : 因为您思想封闭、墨守成规！

lines.en: : And it’s our job as your loving students to pull you out and teach you just as many things as you teach us!
lines.zh: : 而作为爱您的学生，我们的职责就是把您拉出来，教您和您教我们一样多的东西！

lines.en: : I haven’t taught you anything, though.
lines.zh: : 可我什么都没教过你们啊。

lines.en: : Well then...make it up to us or something!
lines.zh: : 那……就补偿我们呗！

lines.en: : Ayane and I have to get the ball rolling!
lines.zh: : 我和 Ayane 得让球滚起来了！

lines.en: : That we do!
lines.zh: : 没错！

lines.en: : And remember, Sensei. Do not judge. Just {i}feel{/i}.
lines.zh: : 记住，Sensei。别评判。只管{i}感受{/i}。

lines.en: scene black
I can already tell that I am going to hate this.
lines.zh: 我已经能预感到，我会恨死这一场。

lines.en: scene rapbattle6
: Hey! Come to cheer on Ayane, Sensei?
lines.zh: : 嘿！是来给 Ayane 加油的吗，Sensei？

lines.en: : I came here to see girls in maid outfits.
lines.zh: : 我是来看穿女仆装的女生才来的。

lines.en: : Want me to go get changed?
lines.zh: : 要我去换一身吗？

lines.en: : Kind of, but that would make it weird for literally everyone else.
lines.zh: : 有点想，不过那样对在场所有人来说都很怪。

lines.en: : Little bit.
lines.zh: : 是有点。

lines.en: : I like maids as much as the next person, but there’s a time and place for everything.
lines.zh: : 我跟别人一样喜欢女仆装，不过什么事都得挑时间地点。

lines.en: : And that time and place is whenever Sensei wants, wherever he wants.
lines.zh: : 而那个时间地点，就是 Sensei 想什么时候、想在什么地方。

lines.en: : I’ll go get changed.
lines.zh: : 我去换了。

lines.en: : It’s fine. Don’t worry about it.
lines.zh: : 没关系。别折腾了。

lines.en: : Also, do either of you two know anything about “feeling” rap?
lines.zh: : 还有，你们俩有谁懂什么叫“感受”说唱吗？

lines.en: : There’s three of us, Sensei. Maya is right there.
lines.zh: : 我们是三个人，Sensei。Maya 就在这儿呢。

lines.en: : No I’m not. Please ignore me.
lines.zh: : 我不在。请无视我。

lines.en: : I feel like Maya knows even less about rap than I do.
lines.zh: : 我觉得 Maya 对说唱的了解比我还少。

lines.en: : For once, you are definitely not wrong.
lines.zh: : 这次你倒是绝对没说错。

lines.en: : It’s kinda just like...if you wanna move your body. Or if you hear a phrase or lyric that stands out in your mind.
lines.zh: : 大概就是……看你身体想不想动。或者有没有听到一句让你印象深刻的词或歌词。

lines.en: : Think of all those poems you used to read me when I was little and stuff. There were always lines that you were teaching me the importance of.
lines.zh: : 想想我小时候您给我念的那些诗。里面总有些句子，您会专门教我它们的重要性。

lines.en: : I think anything that makes you feel like that in song form is what you’re supposed to feel tonight...or something.
lines.zh: : 我觉得，能让您在歌里产生那种感觉的东西，就是今晚您该去感受的……大概吧。

lines.en: : Granted, it’s two [teenage]girls who have never rap battled before freestyling at each other, so I think we can fully expect to feel absolutely nothing throughout this entire contest.
lines.zh: : 不过话说回来，这是两个从没打过说唱对决的[teenage]女生在互相 freestyle，所以我觉得整场比赛我们大概什么都感受不到。

lines.en: : Yeah, I can’t imagine this going well...but I guess we’ll have to-
lines.zh: : 是啊，我想象不出这能顺利……不过我们大概得——

lines.en: : Hey. You there. Imbecile.
lines.zh: : 喂。说你呢。蠢货。

lines.en: scene rapbattle7
: Oh, you two are here.
lines.zh: : 哦，你们两位也在啊。

lines.en: : We are here.
lines.zh: : 我们是在这儿。

lines.en: : Now, tell me, who is the girl in the cute dress?
lines.zh: : 现在告诉我，那个穿可爱裙子的女生是谁？

lines.en: : Wakana Watabe.
lines.zh: : Wakana Watabe。

lines.en: scene rapbattle8
: Not me, you fucking idiot. The tiny one.
lines.zh: : 不是我，你这白痴。是那个小不点。

lines.en: : Also, be careful about what you say to me in front of Osako. She can snap your neck with just two fingers.
lines.zh: : 还有，在 Osako 面前说话注意点。她用两根手指就能拧断你的脖子。

lines.en: : It would probably take a whole hand, but yeah.
lines.zh: : 大概得用上一整只手，不过差不多吧。

lines.en: : Terrifying.
lines.zh: : 真吓人。

lines.en: : Anyway, that girl in the dress is Sana Sakakibara. I figured you’d remember her considering you ordered like fifty beers from her that one time.
lines.zh: : 总之，那个穿裙子的女生是 Sana Sakakibara。我以为您会记得她，毕竟您有一次从她那儿点了大概五十杯啤酒。

lines.en: : That’s exactly {i}why{/i} she can’t remember...
lines.zh: : 这就是她想不起来的{i}原因{/i}……

lines.en: : I had to carry her up the stairs when we got home.
lines.zh: : 回家的时候还是我把她背上楼的。

lines.en: scene rapbattle9
: Ooooohhh...
: Yeah, I don’t remember you at all.
lines.zh: : 是啊，我一点都不记得你了。

lines.en: : I’m...also in the class next door to yours but...I don’t really talk much, so...
lines.zh: : 我……也在你们隔壁班，不过……我不太爱说话，所以……

lines.en: : Good. You’ll absorb lessons better if you sit there and shut up. I’m surprised someone like you even exists in this man’s class.
lines.zh: : 很好。安安静静坐着，你才能把课听进去。我真没想到这个男人的班上居然会有你这种人。

lines.en: : Sensei...has actually helped me a lot and...
lines.zh: : Sensei……其实帮了我很多，而且……

lines.en: : I can help you more. Come to my class instead.
lines.zh: : 我能帮你更多。转来我班上吧。

lines.en: : Sana, come here. Get away from her as quickly as you can or you’ll start talking about how much you want to die every thirty seconds.
lines.zh: : Sana，过来。尽快离她远点，不然你每三十秒就会开始说一次你多想死。

lines.en: scene rapbattle10
: But...I’d never say something like that!
lines.zh: : 可是……我绝对不会说那种话的！

lines.en: : Exactly. Because you are the embodiment of purity and Wakana Watabe is everything impure about the world itself.
lines.zh: : 正是。因为你是纯洁的化身，而 Wakana Watabe 是这世上一切不洁的集合体。

lines.en: : That’s not true. You should see her when she tries cooking dinner. It’s like a whole different Wakana.
lines.zh: : 那倒不是。您该看看她试着做晚饭的样子。简直像换了一个人。

lines.en: : Wakana, please cook dinner for me sometime.
lines.zh: : Wakana，改天请给我做顿晚饭吧。

lines.en: : Osako. His kneecaps, please.
lines.zh: : Osako。他的膝盖骨，劳烦了。

lines.en: : Heheh~ You really like him, don’t you?
lines.zh: : 嘿嘿~ 您真的很喜欢他，对吧？

lines.en: Is this seriously how Wakana shows affection?
lines.zh: 说真的，Wakana 表达好感的方式就是这样？

lines.en: scene rapbattle11
: Hah...listen-
: In the event that you want to actually do something with your life and agree to not undergo any sudden personality shifts that cause you to act out in a rowdy, irresponsible, or uncouth way...
lines.zh: : 要是你真想干点正事，并保证不会突然性情大变、做出粗暴、不负责任或粗鄙的举动……

lines.en: : You may transfer into my class.
lines.zh: : 你可以转进我的班。

lines.en: : You are cute and you are quiet. The ideal combination for a girl of your age and...size.
lines.zh: : 你可爱，又安静。对你这个年纪……和这个体型的女生来说，是最理想的组合。

lines.en: : Thank you?...
: You’re welcome.
lines.zh: : 不客气。

lines.en: : I think that’s the nicest I’ve ever seen her treat anyone that isn’t named Makoto Miyamura.
lines.zh: : 我觉得这是我见过她对别人最温柔的一次了——除了对 Makoto Miyamura。

lines.en: scene rapbattle12
: She’s probably just feeling a little reminded of how she was when she was younger.
lines.zh: : 她大概是想起自己年轻时候的样子了吧。

lines.en: : Wakana’s never had a hard time {i}approaching{/i} people per se, but her social skills have always been a little...lacking.
lines.zh: : Wakana 本身倒不是不敢{i}接近{/i}别人，只是她的社交能力一直有点……欠缺。

lines.en: : When did she start saying her catchphrase?
lines.zh: : 她什么时候开始说那句口头禅的？

lines.en: : She’s been saying that for as long as I’ve known her.
lines.zh: : 我认识她以来她就一直在说。

lines.en: : Then kudos to her for having the willpower to stick it out and not follow through on her desires.
lines.zh: : 那我得佩服她，居然有毅力一直挂在嘴边，却从没真的动手。

lines.en: : I think I have to watch girls yell at each other or something, though, so I’ll catch up with you some other time.
lines.zh: : 不过我大概得去看女生们互相吼了，改天再聊。

lines.en: : Well, we get to keep the dojo now, so there’s always there.
lines.zh: : 好吧，现在道场归我们了，随时欢迎您来。

lines.en: : But yeah, see you around.
lines.zh: : 总之，回头见。

lines.en: scene black
scene rapbattle13
: Ladies and gentlemen! Boys and girls! Molly!
lines.zh: : 女士们先生们！男孩们女孩们！还有 Molly！

lines.en: : Uta, it’s just mean to say that when she’s not even around to react to it.
lines.zh: : Uta，她都不在场，您还这么说，太过分了。

lines.en: : I will speak with the green onion on behalf of the Emerald Guardian. Speak.
lines.zh: : 我愿代表翡翠守卫，与那根青葱对话。说吧。

lines.en: : That won’t be necessary, Tsunecchi! But please relay my words to Molly so she can know she is loved.
lines.zh: : 那就不必了，Tsunecchi！不过请替我把话带给 Molly，让她知道有人爱她。

lines.en: : Uta and I would like to thank everyone for coming out to the main event of night one!
lines.zh: : 我和 Uta 感谢大家前来观看第一晚的主赛事！

lines.en: : We realize that some people have decided to go to the hotel instead, so everyone here will receive a bonus present of one hug from either me or Uta! Your choice!
lines.zh: : 我们知道有些人选择先去酒店了，所以在场的各位都将获得一份特别奖励——我和 Uta 其中一个人的一个拥抱！任您选！

lines.en: : Unless your name is Sensei! Then you have to hug Ayane because my body is still off limits.
lines.zh: : 除非您叫 Sensei！那您只能抱 Ayane，因为我的身体仍然是禁区。

lines.en: : God damnit.
lines.zh: : 妈的。

lines.en: : I’m going to pretend I didn’t hear that!
lines.zh: : 我就当没听见！

lines.en: : Anyway, tonight’s battle will be a standard, single round freestyle exhibition match!
lines.zh: : 总之，今晚的对决是一场标准的单回合自由式表演赛！

lines.en: : Ayane will go first and say some words, then I will go second and say some better words! The end!
lines.zh: : Ayane 先来，说几句词；然后我第二个上，说几句更好的词！就这样！

lines.en: : Weren’t you just talking yesterday about how you weren’t good at “the words?”
lines.zh: : 你昨天不是还在说自己不擅长“词”吗？

lines.en: : Nope! Start the beat, Osako!
lines.zh: : 没有！放拍子，Osako！

lines.en: : Wait, what? Me? Why?
lines.zh: : 等等，什么？我？为什么？

lines.en: : Because you work here and you can reach the PA system in the back!
lines.zh: : 因为您在这儿上班，而且够得到后面的音响设备！

lines.en: : Just go turn on the speakers and press play on my phone! It’s already hooked up.
lines.zh: : 去把音箱打开，然后按我手机上的播放键就行！已经连好了。

lines.en: : Uhh...I mean...I guess if no one else can do it...
lines.zh: : 呃……我是说……要是没别人能干的话……

lines.en: : Stay with us, folks! We should have music any minute now!
lines.zh: : 大家别走开！音乐马上就来！

lines.en: : Any minute now!
lines.zh: : 马上就好！

lines.en: : Uta! You have a text from your dad! Do you want me to read it?
lines.zh: : Uta！您爸爸给您发短信了！要我念给您听吗？

lines.en: : No thank you, Osako! Just press play, please!
lines.zh: : 不用了，Osako！请直接按播放键！

lines.en: scene rapbattle14
: There we go, there we go!
lines.zh: : 来了来了！

lines.en: : Show us what you got, Master-A!
lines.zh: : 让我们瞧瞧您的本事，Master-A！

lines.en: scene black
Uta steps aside and lets Ayane take a more centered position with her microphone.
lines.zh: Uta 退到一旁，让 Ayane 拿着麦克风站到更中间的位置。

lines.en: And, in other news, I feel a lot more uncomfortable than I expected to feel.
lines.zh: 另外插播一条：我现在比预想的还要不自在得多。

lines.en: Which was already very uncomfortable.
lines.zh: 而我本来就已经很不自在了。

lines.en: scene rapbattle15
: I’m sorry in advance for the beats that I drop-\nbut the truth is, {i}bitch{/i}, that my flow can’t be stopped.
lines.zh:
: 我先给在场的各位道个歉，我要开始砸拍子了——
但说实话，{i}婊子{/i}，我的节奏您挡不住。

lines.en: : I’m a legend with the mic and a beast on the stage-\nand you {i}can’t{/i} take my man, we’re already engaged.
lines.zh:
: 我拿着麦克风就是传奇，站在台上就是猛兽——
您{i}抢不走{/i}我的男人，我们早就订了婚。

lines.en: : We are not. That is not true.
lines.zh: : 我们没有。那不是真的。

lines.en: : Shh!
scene rapbattle16
: A battle for Sensei’s a battle I’ll win-\nAny words you spit my way slide right off my skin.
lines.zh:
: 为 Sensei 而战，这场我必赢——
您冲我喷的词，统统从我身上滑下去。

lines.en: : Karate to rapping, my skills are the best\nAnd what do you have, Uta? The size of your chest?
lines.zh:
: 从空手道到说唱，我的本事最顶尖
而您 Uta 又有什么？不过胸前那一对？

lines.en: : It’s surprising you’re small when you talk so damn big-\nMy rhymes crumble mountains, you can’t even snap twigs.
lines.zh:
: 您话说得那么大，人却这么小，真让人惊讶——
我的韵脚能崩碎山岳，您连根树枝都折不断。

lines.en: : A butler named Geoffrey, a chicken named Todd.\nA boyfriend named Sensei, who’s more like my god.
lines.zh:
: 有个管家叫 Geoffrey，有只鸡叫 Todd。
有个男朋友叫 Sensei，他更像我的神。

lines.en: : The list is enormous. It goes on forever.\nTo battle with me is a heavy endeavor.
lines.zh:
: 这份名单长得很，没完没了。
跟我作对，可是件吃力的事。

lines.en: : You up to the task? Gonna run away scared?\nYou nervous? You frightened? Do your thoughts feel impaired?
lines.zh:
: 您敢接招吗？要吓得逃走吗？
您紧张？您害怕？脑子是不是不好使了？

lines.en: : You sit there and smile, but I feel it inside-\nYou’re a scared little girl. So go run away. {i}Hide.{/i}
lines.zh:
: 您坐在那儿笑，可我感觉到您心里——
您就是个害怕的小女孩。快跑吧。{i}躲起来{/i}。

lines.en: : Didn’t think for a second we’d be doing it my way\nStill I’m here in control because, bitch, I’m Ayane.
lines.zh:
: 我从没想过我们会按我的方式来
可我依然掌控全场，因为，婊子，我是 Ayane。

lines.en: : A princess. A queen. Ride to[school] in a Lexus.\nWith so many guns that you’d think I’m from Texas.
lines.zh:
: 一位公主。一位女王。坐着雷克萨斯去[school]。
带的枪多到您会以为我来自得州。

lines.en: : The dorm war is over. I’ve already won it.
lines.zh: : 宿舍大战结束了。我早就赢了。

lines.en: : Uta’s the ground. Ayane’s the summit.
lines.zh: : Uta 是地面。Ayane 是顶峰。

lines.en: scene rapbattle17
: Okay okay okay! Short, but sweet! Color me impressed!
lines.zh: : 好好好！短是短，但够劲！让我刮目相看！

lines.en: : Gotta say, Ayane, you did pretty darn good just now.
lines.zh: : 我得说，Ayane，您刚才表现得相当不错。

lines.en: : Think you still have a chance?
lines.zh: : 觉得您还有机会？

lines.en: : A chance? Ha.
lines.zh: : 机会？哈。

lines.en: : Listen up, {i}princess...{/i}
lines.zh: : 听好了，{i}公主殿下……{/i}

lines.en: scene rapbattle18
: My feelings are hurt, guys! What on earth should I do?
lines.zh: : 我的感情受伤了，各位！我到底该怎么办啊？

lines.en: : Should I listen to her and give up on round two?
lines.zh: : 我要不要听她的，放弃第二回合？

lines.en: : Or should I take her to[school]?\nSit her down at her chair?\nTeach her not to step up 'less she's truly prepared?
lines.zh:
: 还是该带她去[school]？
让她在椅子上坐好？
教她没准备好就别上来？

lines.en: scene rapbattle20
: Your rapping was good. Hell, it was even expressive.\nBut to mention my breasts is a tad unimpressive.
lines.zh:
: 您的说唱不错。操，甚至还挺有感情。
可拿我的胸来开嘲，就有点掉价了。

lines.en: : You’re better than that. It was really unsightly.\nBut of course you play dirty when you [masturbate] nightly.
lines.zh:
: 您不该这样。那样真的很难看。
不过您当然会玩阴的，谁让您每晚都[masturbate]。

lines.en: : The world's greatest maid don’t need slander for victory.\n She thinks winning like that'd be too contradictory.
lines.zh:
: 世界第一的女仆不需要靠诋毁取胜。
她觉得那样赢下来，未免太自相矛盾。

lines.en: : Cause I know you and me don’t have all that much history-\nAnd this freestyle’s your intro, while it’s my valedictory.
lines.zh:
: 因为我知道您和我之间并没有多少过往——
这场 freestyle 是您的开场白，却是我的告别辞。

lines.en: scene rapbattle19
: Ha! I said “dictory.” And dick’s slang for penis.\nBut Ayane probs knows this since she’s so libidinous.
lines.zh:
: 哈！我说了“告别辞”，而 dictory 里的 dick 就是鸡巴。
不过 Ayane 大概最懂这个，毕竟她那么欲求不满。

lines.en: : Is Uta a genius? Does anyone see this?\nDoes she have an IV?\nAre these rhymes intravenous?
lines.zh:
: Uta 是天才吗？有人看到没？
她是不是挂着点滴？
难道这些韵脚是静脉注射的？

lines.en: scene rapbattle20
: You say I’m the ground...and you are the summit.\nThing is, after this battle, your stock’s gonna plummet.
lines.zh:
: 您说我是地面……而您是顶峰。
问题是，这场对决之后，您的身价要暴跌。

lines.en: : Why should you win when you fight with no dignity?\nAnd why should I fail from your selfish malignity?
lines.zh:
: 您打得毫无尊严，凭什么赢？
我又凭什么败给您那自私的恶意？

lines.en: : Why even rap? Why not fight differently?\nCause you might have weapons, but I’ve got creativity.
lines.zh:
: 何必说唱？换个打法不行吗？
因为您有武器，而我有创造力。

lines.en: : It's a battle of boring versus sheer versatility.\nAnd yeah, you might have Sensei, but I’ve got my virginity.
lines.zh:
: 这是一场无聊对多才多艺的比拼。
没错，您也许有 Sensei，可我有我的处子之身。

lines.en: scene rapbattle21
: Wait, what? That’s just part of the rap, right?
lines.zh: : 等等，什么？那只是说唱的一部分，对吧？

lines.en: : Hahahahahahah! Oh my god!
lines.zh: : 哈哈哈哈哈哈哈！我的天啊！

lines.en: : Holy shit. Uta’s actually really good.
lines.zh: : 卧槽。Uta 是真的强。

lines.en: : She’s...probably just trying to get a rise out of Ayane. That’s how these contests go, Ami.
lines.zh: : 她……大概只是在故意激怒 Ayane。这种比赛都这样，Ami。

lines.en: : I thought you didn’t know anything about rap?
lines.zh: : 你不是说自己对说唱一窍不通吗？

lines.en: : You’re disgusting.
lines.zh: : 您真恶心。

lines.en: : Uhhh...Uta? That’s enough. And you probably shouldn’t say things like that when the entire class is-
lines.zh: : 呃……Uta？够了。而且全班都在的时候，您大概不该说那种话——

lines.en: : I’m so heckin’ sorry. I’m just in the zone.\nSee when I have the mic, it gets a mind of its own.
lines.zh:
: 我真的非常抱歉。我只是进入状态了。
看，我一拿到麦克风，它就有了自己的意志。

lines.en: : I don’t claim to be perfect. I don’t own the world.\nAnd yeah, I am short. But I’m no little girl.
lines.zh:
: 我没说自己完美。我也不拥有全世界。
对，我个子矮。可我不是小丫头。

lines.en: : I’m Uta, you see. There’s no one like me.\nA reincarnated rap god that’s finally set free.
lines.zh:
: 我是 Uta，您看。没人跟我一样。
一位转世的说唱之神，终于获得自由。

lines.en: scene rapbattle22
: So I hope that this all leaves a lasting impression.
lines.zh: : 希望这一切能给您留下深刻的印象。

lines.en: : Now take a seat, bitch...cause class is in session.
lines.zh: : 现在坐下吧，婊子……因为要上课了。

lines.en: : What up?
lines.zh: : 怎么样？

lines.en: : Encore! Encore!
lines.zh: : 再来一个！再来一个！

lines.en: scene black
scene rapbattle23
: And you said you didn’t want to come here tonight.
lines.zh: : 你不是说今晚不想来的吗。

lines.en: : Shouldn’t you be a little more pissed off after that virginity comment?
lines.zh: : 听完那句处女的发言，你不该更火大一点吗？

lines.en: : That was just Uta calling Ayane slutty. It doesn’t mean she knows something about her.
lines.zh: : 那只是 Uta 在说 Ayane 浪而已。不代表她真知道什么。

lines.en: : The two of them only like, just started hanging out I think.
lines.zh: : 她们俩好像也是最近才开始一起玩的。

lines.en: : That green onion can really spit.
lines.zh: : 那根青葱还真能喷。

lines.en: scene rapbattle24
: Did someone tell you to say that, Tsuneyo?
lines.zh: : 是有人教您这么说的吗，Tsuneyo？

lines.en: : I felt it in my heart.
lines.zh: : 我用心感受到了。

lines.en: : Though that could just be heartburn.
lines.zh: : 虽然那也可能是胃灼热。

lines.en: : So...contest is basically over then, right?
lines.zh: : 那么……比赛基本上结束了吧？

lines.en: : We’ve still gotta wait for Sensei to choose the winner.
lines.zh: : 我们还得等 Sensei 选出胜者。

lines.en: : Well at least we know if he chooses Ayane that there’s a clear bias thing going on.
lines.zh: : 不过至少我们知道，要是他选 Ayane，那就是明摆着偏心。

lines.en: : I don’t care about music at all, but even I can tell she was the loser there.
lines.zh: : 我对音乐一点兴趣都没有，可连我都看得出她是输的那个。

lines.en: : Fuckin’ midget girl was sayin’ words I’ve never even fuckin’ heard before.
lines.zh: : 那个死矮子说的词我他妈听都没听过。

lines.en: scene black
scene rapbattle25
: Well, Sensei! Which one of us do you think did better?
lines.zh: : 那么，Sensei！您觉得我们俩谁表现更好？

lines.en: : Keep in mind that whoever you choose will have a point added onto their team’s total!
lines.zh: : 提醒您，您选谁，谁的队伍总分就会加一分！

lines.en: While it’s true that Uta’s rap was definitely...more detailed, I don’t know if I really {i}felt{/i} anything.
lines.zh: 虽然 Uta 的说唱确实……更花哨，但我不知道自己是否真的{i}感受到了{/i}什么。

lines.en: I mean, I didn’t really feel anything from Ayane’s either, but that’s probably because I just don’t like rap.
lines.zh: 我的意思是，Ayane 的那段我也没感受到什么，不过那大概只是因为我不喜欢说唱。

lines.en: Tonight absolutely did not change that.
lines.zh: 今晚绝对没有改变这一点。

lines.en: Ayane {i}did{/i} call me her god, though...so...
lines.zh: 不过 Ayane {i}确实{/i}叫我她的神了……所以……

lines.en: : The person I choose is...
lines.zh: : 我选的人是……

lines.en: scene rapbattle26
: Wait.
lines.zh: : 等等。

lines.en: : What do you mean wait? This is the most important part.
lines.zh: : 等等是什么意思？这可是最重要的部分。

lines.en: : Sensei, you should choose Uta.
lines.zh: : Sensei，您该选 Uta。

lines.en: : She’s clearly much better at this than I am and deserves the victory, as much as it pains me to say that.
lines.zh: : 她明显比我强得多，这场胜利她当之无愧——虽然说出来让我很痛心。

lines.en: : Hey...you did great, too. Maybe Sensei liked yours more? It’s really up to him.
lines.zh: : 嘿……您也很棒啊。也许 Sensei 更喜欢您那段呢？这全看他。

lines.en: scene rapbattle27
: Sensei will just wind up looking biased if he picks me.
lines.zh: : 要是他选我，最后只会显得他有偏心。

lines.en: : And after your...virginity comment, we should probably make sure that my relationship with him doesn’t snowball into something that will get him in trouble.
lines.zh: : 而且在您说了那句……处女之后，我们大概得确保我和他的关系不会滚雪球一样变成会给他惹麻烦的东西。

lines.en: : I was just makin’ a joke. I don’t know the first thing about your sex life.
lines.zh: : 我只是开个玩笑。我对您的性生活一无所知。

lines.en: : Want me to go around and clear that up with everybody, or-
lines.zh: : 要不要我去跟所有人澄清一下，还是——

lines.en: : It’s fine. Really, don’t worry about it.
lines.zh: : 没事。真的，别担心。

lines.en: scene rapbattle28
: Everyone! I am conceding the competition to Uta as she was the clear victor!
lines.zh: : 各位！我宣布把这场比赛让给 Uta，她才是明显的赢家！

lines.en: : If Makoto asks, just tell her Sensei picked her instead! I don’t want to get yelled at for “quitting.”
lines.zh: : 要是 Makoto 问起来，就说是 Sensei 选了她！我可不想因为“弃权”被骂。

lines.en: : Yeah...I love you, Ayane, but you definitely lost.
lines.zh: : 是啊……我爱你，Ayane，但这场您确实输了。

lines.en: : More people should be talking about Uta’s sudden extreme increase in vocabulary. That was weird.
lines.zh: : 大家更应该讨论的是 Uta 词汇量怎么突然暴涨。太诡异了。

lines.en: : Yeah, what happened to being bad with words?
lines.zh: : 是啊，你说自己不擅长措辞是怎么回事？

lines.en: : Didn’t you hear my rap, Sensei? The mic had a mind of its own. I’m just little ole’ Uta.
lines.zh: : 您没听我的说唱吗，Sensei？麦克风有自己的意志。我只是那个小小的 Uta 罢了。

lines.en: if ayanelust10 == True and ayane_lust >= 15 and kirin_lust >= 15:
scene rapbattle29
: So, now that the final competition is over, should we start heading over to the hotel to meet up with the rest of the girls?
lines.zh: : 那么，既然最后一场比赛结束了，我们要不要出发去酒店和其他女生汇合？

lines.en: : Wanna come sleep in our room to celebrate my victory, Sensei?
lines.zh: : Sensei，要不要来我们房间睡，庆祝我的胜利？

lines.en: : Ooooooor, you could come sleep in {i}our{/i} room to reward me for my generous concession.
lines.zh: : 或——者，您也可以来{i}我们{/i}房间睡，作为对我慷慨让赛的奖励。

lines.en: : But Ayane, what would people think after my totally serious virginity comment?
lines.zh: : 可是 Ayane，我那句处女宣言可是认真的，别人会怎么想啊？

lines.en: : Perhaps being under the supervision of nine other girls will be enough to dispel any rumors?
lines.zh: : 有其他九个女生在旁边看着，大概足以打消一切流言了吧？

lines.en: : Or, if Sensei wants to just give up on his career and be with me and only me for forever starting right now, it would also be a good time.
lines.zh: : 或者，如果 Sensei 想干脆放弃事业，从现在起永远只和我一个人在一起，现在也是个好时机。

lines.en: : Or, alternatively, the three of us could get our own room and celebrate by-
lines.zh: : 或者换个方案，我们三个自己开一间房，然后靠……庆祝——

lines.en: : Ayaneeeeeeee~
lines.zh: : Ayaneeeeeeee~

lines.en: scene rapbattle30
Kirin comes trotting over to the three of us and quickly steals away Ayane’s attention.
lines.zh: Kirin 小跑着来到我们三人身边，迅速把 Ayane 的注意力抢了过去。

lines.en: : What do you want?
lines.zh: : 你想干什么？

lines.en: : I just want to talk for a little while. Is that okay?
lines.zh: : 我只是想聊一会儿。行吗？

lines.en: : About?
lines.zh: : 聊什么？

lines.en: : Stuuuuuuuff~
lines.zh: : 一——些事~

lines.en: : It would be nice if we could talk in private, though.
lines.zh: : 不过要是能私下聊就更好了。

lines.en: : Why’s Kirin actin’ all weird?
lines.zh: : Kirin 怎么怪怪的？

lines.en: : It’s probably best not to ask.
lines.zh: : 大概还是别问比较好。

lines.en: : Ayane, do you need me to stay here? Or do you want to talk to her?
lines.zh: : Ayane，你要我留在这儿吗？还是你想跟她聊聊？

lines.en: : You can go, Sensei. I’ll be fine.
lines.zh: : 您可以走了，Sensei。我没事的。

lines.en: scene black
Uta and I walk away from Ayane as Kirin approaches and begin to clean up the maid cafe with the rest of the girls.
lines.zh: Kirin 走近时，我和 Uta 从 Ayane 身边走开，开始和其他女生一起打扫女仆咖啡店。

lines.en: Even Wakana and Osako chip in, so-
lines.zh: 连 Wakana 和 Osako 也来帮忙了，所以——

lines.en: Well, I guess Osako works here. So that isn’t really much of a surprise.
lines.zh: 好吧，Osako 本来就在店里上班。所以这也没什么好意外的。

lines.en: Either way, all of us start tidying things up while Kirin pulls Ayane to the side.
lines.zh: 不管怎样，我们大家开始收拾，而 Kirin 把 Ayane 拉到了一边。

lines.en: I try to listen in, but I’m not able to catch any of what is discussed.
lines.zh: 我试着偷听，可什么都没听到。

lines.en: scene rapbattle31
: Hey! Great job up there. You really impressed me.
lines.zh: : 嘿！刚才表现不错。真让我刮目相看。

lines.en: : Kind of cool that you gave the win to Uta, though. She deserved it with all those crazy rhymes.
lines.zh: : 你把胜利让给 Uta 也挺酷的。就凭那些疯狂的韵脚，她配得上。

lines.en: : Like, where did all of that even come from? Hahahaha!
lines.zh: : 说真的，那些都是打哪儿冒出来的？哈哈哈哈！

lines.en: : Just get to the point, Kirin. You wouldn’t have needed to pull me away from Uta and Sensei if you were just going to talk about this.
lines.zh: : 有话直说，Kirin。要是你只想聊这个，根本用不着把我从 Uta 和 Sensei 身边拉开。

lines.en: : What the fuck do you know about what I would or wouldn’t do? I’m just trying to be nice.
lines.zh: : 我会做什么、不会做什么，你他妈懂什么？我只是想友好一点。

lines.en: : And that’s it? There’s nothing else you want?
lines.zh: : 就这样？你没有别的事？

lines.en: : Actually...there {i}is{/i} something.
lines.zh: : 其实……还真{i}有{/i}一件事。

lines.en: : See, I lost my contest today too. So we both let our teams down pretty badly.
lines.zh: : 你看，我今天也输掉了自己的比赛。所以我们都把各自的队伍坑得挺惨。

lines.en: : No one expected you to beat Miku, so you didn’t let anyone down.
lines.zh: : 没人指望你能赢 Miku，所以你没有让谁失望。

lines.en: : That might be true, but I still can’t help but beat myself up over it. You know?
lines.zh: : 也许吧，可我还是忍不住为这事自责。你懂吗？

lines.en: : And? What are you getting at?
lines.zh: : 然后呢？你想说什么？

lines.en: : Hmm...
: Come here.
lines.zh: : 过来。

lines.en: : I don’t-
lines.zh: : 我不——

lines.en: : Fine, I’ll just whisper it into your ear then.
lines.zh: : 行，那我就直接凑到你耳边说。

lines.en: scene rapbattle32
scene rapbattle33
: Are you kidding?
lines.zh: : 你在开玩笑吗？

lines.en: : Is this a joke?
lines.zh: : 这是玩笑吗？

lines.en: scene rapbattle34
: Come on~ I think it sounds fun.
lines.zh: : 来嘛~ 我觉得听起来挺有意思的。

lines.en: : Just the once and I won’t bother you about it anymore.
lines.zh: : 就这一次，以后我再也不烦你了。

lines.en: : That’s what you said last time.
lines.zh: : 你上次也是这么说的。

lines.en: : I know, I know, but...well, you know how hormones work and all that.
lines.zh: : 我知道，我知道，不过……嗯，你也知道荷尔蒙是怎么回事。

lines.en: : Anyway, I’ll come pick you up when I’m ready. Sound good?
lines.zh: : 总之，我准备好了就来找你。行吗？

lines.en: : Why are you doing this to me?
lines.zh: : 你为什么要这么对我？

lines.en: : Cause I’m horny. Duh.
lines.zh: : 因为我发情了呗。废话。

lines.en: : Anyway, nice talking to you. And good job with your rapping and stuff.
lines.zh: : 总之，聊得愉快。你那段说唱也唱得不错。

lines.en: : See you tonight, Ayane.
lines.zh: : 晚上见，Ayane。

lines.en: scene black
Welp, I guess that about wraps it up for the first day of competitions.
lines.zh: 唉，我想第一天的比赛差不多就这样结束了。

lines.en: I have no idea what tomorrow is going to bring, but if it’s even a fraction as...exciting as it was today, I am going to have to call out of work on Monday to recuperate.
lines.zh: 我不知道明天会带来什么，但只要它哪怕有今天的几分之一……刺激，我就得周一请假好好缓一缓。

lines.en: We all finish cleaning up the maid cafe within thirty minutes or so and then make our way through the cold of the night to the hotel...
lines.zh: 我们大概三十分钟就把女仆咖啡店收拾完了，然后穿过夜里的寒意前往酒店……

scene rapbattle29
: So, now that the final competition is over, should we start heading over to the hotel to meet up with the rest of the girls?
lines.zh: : 那么，既然最后一场比赛结束了，我们要不要出发去酒店和其他女生汇合？

lines.en: : Wanna come sleep in our room to celebrate my victory, Sensei?
lines.zh: : Sensei，要不要来我们房间睡，庆祝我的胜利？

lines.en: : Ooooooor, you could come sleep in {i}our{/i} room to reward me for my generous concession.
lines.zh: : 或——者，您也可以来{i}我们{/i}房间睡，作为对我慷慨让赛的奖励。

lines.en: : But Ayane, what would people think after my totally serious virginity comment?
lines.zh: : 可是 Ayane，我那句处女宣言可是认真的，别人会怎么想啊？

lines.en: : Perhaps being under the supervision of nine other girls will be enough to dispel any rumors?
lines.zh: : 有其他九个女生在旁边看着，大概足以打消一切流言了吧？

lines.en: : Or, if Sensei wants to just give up on his career and be with me and me only for forever starting right now, it would also be a good time.
lines.zh: : 或者，如果 Sensei 想干脆放弃事业，从现在起永远只和我一个人在一起，现在也是个好时机。

lines.en: : Or, alternatively, the three of us could get our own room and celebrate by-
lines.zh: : 或者换个方案，我们三个自己开一间房，然后靠……庆祝——

lines.en: : Nope!
lines.zh: : 不行！

lines.en: : I mean...{i}I{/i} didn’t say no...
lines.zh: : {i}我{/i}的意思是……我也没说不行……

lines.en: scene black
Everyone (Except me) works together to clean up the maid cafe and, within the next twenty minutes or so, we begin our journey to the hotel.
lines.zh: 除了我之外，大家一起动手打扫女仆咖啡店，大约二十分钟后，我们便动身前往酒店。

lines.en: Thankfully, it isn’t {i}that{/i} far from where we are now, so the walk doesn’t take that long.
lines.zh: 幸好酒店离这儿不算远，{i}所以{/i}走过去没花多少时间。

lines.en: But anyway, I guess that wraps it up for the first day of competitions.
lines.zh: 总之，我想第一天的比赛就这样结束了。

lines.en: I have no idea what tomorrow is going to bring, but if it’s even a fraction as...exciting as it was today, I am going to have to call out of work on Monday to recuperate.
lines.zh: 我不知道明天会带来什么，但只要它哪怕有今天的几分之一……刺激，我就得周一请假好好缓一缓。
